User story: "As a registered customer, I want to log in to the Sauce Demo store at https://www.saucedemo.com so that I can reach the product catalogue. Acceptance criteria: the login form has a username field [data-test="username"], a password field [data-test="password"] and a login button [data-test="login-button"]; logging in with username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce' redirects to a URL containing '/inventory.html' and shows the page title element '.title' with the text 'Products'."
Category: authentication
Complexity: simple
Return the Cypress script only.
